3-501.  MEETINGS IN CITIES OF THE FIRST AND SECOND CLASS.

3-502.  TIME, PLACE - EXCEPTIONS.
The governing body shall hold one regular meeting which shall be held on the second Thursday of each month at the Altamont Town Hall, which meeting shall begin promptly at 7:00 o'clock p.m., during mountain standard time and at 7:00 o'clock p.m., during mountain daylight time provided that:
A.     If the meeting date is a legal holiday, then the meeting shall be held at the same time and place above described on the next following day which is not a legal holiday.
B.      The governing body may by resolution provide for a different time and place for holding regular meetings of the governing body.
